races.paceDynamic: Celandine will dictate from the front with Hold A Dream and Paris Babe settling prominent positions behind her. With only one confirmed leader and two prominent runners, Celandine can establish a comfortable rhythm without early pressure. The hold-up specialists Rosy Affair, Sky Majesty, Sayidah Dariyan and Flora Of Bermuda will track the pace from midfield positions. This setup creates a sustainable tempo that strongly favours the hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks over this sharp 6f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Specialist Delivers
scenarios.trigger: If Celandine sets an uncontested lead allowing the race to develop at a steady tempo
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up runners prove decisive as they have energy reserves for strong finishes. Rosy Affair, Sky Majesty or Sayidah Dariyan can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Hold A Dream or Paris Babe fail to support Celandine early, creating a crawling pace
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows Celandine to steal the race or gives prominent runners like Hold A Dream the perfect setup for a sustained drive. Hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the slow tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Hold A Dream and Paris Babe both press Celandine creating genuine early pace
scenarios.body: The strong gallop sets up perfectly for a closer with the best finishing kick. Sky Majesty or Flora Of Bermuda benefit most from the solid tempo to unleash their superior class.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Running Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If Celandine gets completely uncontested fractions and the field fails to respond
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage that the closers cannot peg back over the short 6f trip. Celandine stays on strongly to hold off all challengers.

watchPoints.text: If Hold A Dream and Paris Babe both sit off Celandine early, she could steal a march with uncontested fractions
Watch for Sky Majesty's position turning in - if she's too far back the pace may not be strong enough for her finishing kick
Flora Of Bermuda needs to show early signs of enthusiasm given her recent poor form and long absence
Rosy Affair's 245-day break is a concern despite her proven class and suitable running style for this race shape
The prominent runners Hold A Dream and Paris Babe must commit to supporting early pace rather than sitting back

races.paceDynamic: Jakajaro and Apollo One will likely lead this field early, with El Bodon potentially pressing if connections are aggressive. The presence of just one confirmed front-runner in Jakajaro suggests a measured early gallop without excessive pressure. With the majority of this field preferring to sit off the pace (Double Rush, Addison Grey, Invictus Gold, Brian, Coul Angel, Indian Run, Sir Les Patterson all hold-up types), there's a significant risk of the pace becoming too slow. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers and front-runners who can control the tempo and have first run when the pace quickens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Jakajaro gets an uncontested lead and dictates steady fractions
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too sedate for the hold-up brigade to make up ground effectively in the sprint finish. Jakajaro or Apollo One can kick clear before the pack mobilizes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and multiple hold-up horses are still in contention turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final two furlongs favouring the classiest closers with tactical speed. Higher-rated horses with proven finishing kicks dominate.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If Apollo One and El Bodon apply enough pressure to Jakajaro to create honest fractions
scenarios.body: The race unfolds at a fair tempo that suits horses with tactical pace who can position prominently without overracing. Mid-pack runners with good acceleration benefit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Jakajaro for the lead creating excessive early pace
scenarios.body: The front-runners tie up in the final furlong allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past with strong late runs. The best stayers over six furlongs capitalize.

watchPoints.text: If Jakajaro gets a soft lead and easy fractions, the hold-up horses may struggle to peg him back
Apollo One's fitness after 63-day break could be questionable despite his prominent running style suiting the race shape
William Buick on Coul Angel and James Doyle on Indian Run both have tactical flexibility to adapt if the pace develops differently
Indian Run's 264-day layoff represents a significant fitness concern despite the talented jockey booking
Watch for early positioning as the eight hold-up horses will be competing for limited racing room in the closing stages

races.paceDynamic: Alcarath and Thunder Wonder are both confirmed front-runners who will likely contest the early lead, with Alcarath's proven ability to make all at Epsom suggesting he'll be the primary pace-setter. The presence of two natural leaders should create an honest gallop rather than a crawl, with prominent runners like Bullet Point, Botanical, and Mister Winston tracking just behind. This sustained tempo will stretch the field and expose the large contingent of hold-up horses who need to find gaps late. The genuine pace and 1m1f distance strongly favours prominent racers who can position handily and kick when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Alcarath and Thunder Wonder engage in a genuine speed duel from the start
scenarios.body: The honest tempo suits horses who can track the leaders without being too far back, allowing them to strike when the pace-setters tire in the final furlong. Bullet Point and Botanical are perfectly positioned to benefit from this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Alcarath Dominates Again
scenarios.trigger: If Alcarath can establish a clear lead like his Epsom romp and Thunder Wonder fails to go with him
scenarios.body: The lack of serious pressure allows Alcarath to dictate terms and potentially stay on strongly, though his 658-day layoff remains a concern. This scenario particularly hurts the hold-up brigade who need stronger pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate despite two leaders being present
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with enough time to wind up their finishing kicks from the back. Fifth Column and Astro King would be the primary beneficiaries of any tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Alcarath and Thunder Wonder go too fast too early and burn out completely
scenarios.body: This creates chaos in the final stages as the field bunches up behind tired leaders. Mid-division runners with tactical pace like The Lost King could capitalize on the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Thunder Wonder and Alcarath could go too fast early and set this up for a closer, particularly if both are keen

Astro King's 658-day layoff is extreme even for a seasoned campaigner and he may need this desperately
The Lost King's excellent recent form makes him dangerous if he can get competitive from his prominent position

races.paceDynamic: Night Raider and Five Ways will contest the early lead, with Night Raider likely to get first run given his more consistent front-running record. Six horses want prominent positions (Asfoora, Quinault, Washington Heights, Rumstar, Jm Jungle, Frost At Dawn), creating a bunched group tracking the leaders through the first two furlongs. The pace should be genuine but not suicidal, with the front pair keeping it honest while the prominent brigade jostle for position behind. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and produce late runs down the outside.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes interference and the pace stays strong enough
scenarios.body: The six prominent runners will get in each other's way turning for home, while the pace-setters weaken in the final furlong. Clean late runs from the back prove decisive as tired legs up front can't respond.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the six prominent horses secures a perfect stalking position without interference
scenarios.body: Asfoora or Quinault gets the cleaner trip of the prominent group and kicks clear approaching the final furlong. The hold-up horses have too much to do from the back despite the honest pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Night Raider or Five Ways gets soft fractions and the prominent group doesn't press hard enough
scenarios.body: The early leader gets away with easier splits than expected and has enough left to resist late challengers. The prominent horses fail to apply sufficient pressure through the middle stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos sprint finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with the front pair going too slow and prominent horses waiting
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint from the 2f pole with horses coming from all angles. Any horse with a clear run and finishing kick can win regardless of early position.

watchPoints.text: Night Raider and Five Ways must both go forward early - if one hesitates the pace could collapse
Six horses wanting prominent positions creates bunching risk approaching the 2f pole
Quinault's claimer Jason Ghiani may get squeezed out in the prominent traffic
Shagraan needs the pace to be genuine enough to set up his hold-up style
First Instinct showed ring-rustiness last time so needs to travel smoothly into contention

races.paceDynamic: Into The Sky and Venetian Prince will force the early pace from the gates, with Into The Sky likely to grab the lead given his confirmed front-running style. Six horses (Gstaad, King's Trail, Alparslan, Padraig Dawn, Power Blue, Oxagon) want prominent positions creating inevitable traffic problems turning for home. The honest gallop set by the two leaders will stretch the field, but the prominent congestion means several fancied runners risk getting shuffled back at the crucial moment. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and the genuine front-runners who avoid the squeeze.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest pace favours closers
scenarios.trigger: If Into The Sky and Venetian Prince maintain strong gallop without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The even tempo allows hold-up horses to close effectively while the prominent brigade gets caught in traffic turning for home. Clean runs from the back prove decisive as stamina tells in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Into The Sky or Venetian Prince gets easy fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The leader exploits soft sectionals to build an unassailable advantage while the field behind scrambles for position. The pace-setter has too much in hand when the closers finally get organized.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent pace clash
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners engage in early pace battle behind the leaders
scenarios.body: The sustained pressure from multiple horses creates a fierce gallop that sets up a blanket finish. Class tells as the best horses emerge from the pack in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical sprint finish
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders come back to the field creating a slow early pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with a furious sprint finish favouring horses with the highest cruising speed. Pure class overcomes positional disadvantage in a messy conclusion.

watchPoints.text: Traffic chaos likely at two-furlong marker as six prominent runners (Gstaad, Oxagon, Power Blue, Alparslan, Distant Storm, Thesecretadversary) converge on limited racing room
Into The Sky's 224-day absence could see fitness lacking in final furlong despite front-running advantage
Bow Echo's 217-day break requires close monitoring for sharpness despite perfect strike-rate
Jockey positioning crucial for hold-up horses Needle Match and Avicenna to secure clear runs
Early fractions set by Into The Sky and Venetian Prince will determine if closers can get competitive

races.paceDynamic: Four natural front-runners will create a torrid gallop from the start with Angel Of Anfield, Pilu, Front Line Fury, and Comical Point all wanting the early lead. This strong pace over six furlongs on good to firm ground will stretch the field and test stamina reserves. The relentless tempo will set up perfectly for hold-up horses who can conserve energy early and produce late kicks. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up merchants who can exploit the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all four front-runners engage in early speed battle
scenarios.body: The unsustainable gallop will wilt the leaders in the final furlong, allowing patient hold-up horses with finishing kicks to sweep past tired pace-setters. Fresh finishers will have a significant tactical advantage over the burned-out early leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter breaks clear early while others settle
scenarios.body: Angel Of Anfield or Comical Point could steal a march by avoiding the early speed duel and controlling a more manageable tempo. This controlled pace would suit their natural front-running style while nullifying the closers' finishing advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners track the pace perfectly without getting involved early
scenarios.body: Sovereign Spell and Man Of Vision could get the perfect trip just behind the speed battle, close enough to strike but fresh enough to finish. Their tactical position would allow them to pounce when the leaders weaken while avoiding the traffic problems of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Sustains Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners settle into rhythm after initial jostling
scenarios.body: The early pace-setters could maintain their advantage if they avoid burning each other out in the opening exchanges. This scenario requires tactical restraint from the speed horses and would favour natural front-runners with stamina.

watchPoints.text: Angel Of Anfield, Pilu, and Front Line Fury all returning from 200+ day breaks creating significant fitness concerns for the main pace-setters
Early pace battle between four natural leaders could be so fierce that none survive to contest the finish
Ten Carat Harry gets 5lb weight allowance from claiming jockey which could prove decisive in a tight finish
Market moves on any of the long-absent horses suggesting hidden fitness as connections have kept them away since summer
Track position of Sovereign Spell and Man Of Vision in early stages as perfect stalking trips could set up their victories

races.paceDynamic: Gamrai and Pride Of Donegal will ensure a proper gallop from the start, both confirmed front-runners who won't shirk the early responsibility. With only two natural pace-setters in a nine-runner field, they'll likely work together through steady sectionals rather than tear each other apart. The moderate early pace will allow the large hold-up brigade (Nightime Dancer, Nolton Cross, Daiquiri Bay, Oneforthegutter, Hopewell Rock, Military Academy) to get into ideal striking positions turning for home. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can deliver their finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays steady as expected with just two leaders working
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get perfect positioning and unleash superior finishing speed in the final two furlongs. Class tells as the better-rated runners like Nightime Dancer and Bellum Justum capitalise on ideal race conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Sets Up
scenarios.trigger: If Gamrai and Pride Of Donegal overdo it early and weaken approaching the finish
scenarios.body: Their honest pace creates the perfect setup for the mid-division runners to sweep past in the closing stages. Bellum Justum's prominent style bridges the gap perfectly while Military Academy times his run to perfection.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too pedestrian and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final three furlongs favouring those with natural gate speed. Gamrai's class might just hold on while Pride Of Donegal's recent form gives him every chance of staying on.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters are allowed to get away with soft sectionals throughout
scenarios.body: The leaders steal a march and the hold-up horses are left with too much to do despite their superior ratings. Pride Of Donegal's recent wins show he's in the form of his life.

watchPoints.text: Nightime Dancer faces a serious fitness test after 259 days off despite being the highest-rated runner in the field.

races.paceDynamic: Stellar Vision, Splash, and Try Storm Cat will force a strong early gallop over this 7f trip, with King Of Chaos and Velvet Rhythm likely joining the pace battle from prominent positions. The sustained tempo will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final two furlongs. With five pace-focused runners creating genuine pressure up front, the gallop will be relentless rather than tactical. This fierce pace dynamic strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and deliver late kicks when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too hard early and fade dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The blistering gallop will empty the tanks of Stellar Vision, Splash and Try Storm Cat, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Sierra Sands and Thaluna possess the class and closing kick to capitalise when the pace merchants surrender.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Times Move
scenarios.trigger: If Velvet Rhythm or King Of Chaos can stay close without getting dragged into the early battle
scenarios.body: Racing just off the fierce pace allows one of the prominent runners to strike at the perfect moment when leaders tire but before closers arrive. Velvet Rhythm's light weight and King Of Chaos's recent run give them tactical advantages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Splash can utilise superior class and fitness to outlast his pace rivals
scenarios.body: Despite the strong gallop, Splash's long absence may have freshened him sufficiently to withstand pressure from Stellar Vision and Try Storm Cat. His higher topspeed rating suggests he can kick clear when the other leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters surprisingly go steady early, creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Without the expected fierce gallop, the race becomes a dash from the three-furlong pole where pure acceleration matters most. Sierra Sands with Ryan Moore's tactical brilliance can position perfectly for a devastating late surge.

watchPoints.text: Try Storm Cat and Stellar Vision could set suicidal fractions if both refuse to settle, destroying their winning chances completely
Splash returning from 192-day break may need the run despite topspeed advantage, fitness doubt against race-fit opponents
Thaluna drops significantly in class after 183-day break for Haggas who excels with returning horses at this level
King Of Chaos just 5 days since last run could be vulnerable to fresher opponents despite recent consistent form
Sierra Sands with Ryan Moore represents the most potent hold-up combination if the pace scenario unfolds as expected

races.paceDynamic: Skipper and Earl Of Rochester will lead this field from the gates, with Spanish Voice, Advancing, and Twisting Physics settling prominently behind them. The pace should be honest but sustainable given Skipper's proven front-running ability and lack of pressure from other confirmed leaders. The middle-distance nature and good going will allow the pace to build steadily through the middle sections. This setup strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed, as they can track the pace without being caught too far back when the sprint develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Skipper Controls Again
scenarios.trigger: If Skipper gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: James Doyle can measure out his fractions perfectly on the recent Redcar winner, with the prominent trackers struggling to peg him back. His proven stamina at the trip and current form edge make him the one to beat.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuine and Skipper comes under pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent racers like Spanish Voice and Advancing can track the leaders before unleashing their finishing kicks. Murphy's tactical nous on Spanish Voice becomes crucial in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses like Sterling Knight and Man Of La Mancha get their ideal scenario with a sprint finish developing. Moore's class on Sterling Knight and Man Of La Mancha's proven Group-race ability come to the fore.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Skipper and Earl Of Rochester go too fast early on
scenarios.body: The entire complexion changes with both leaders weakening, allowing a mid-pack runner to steal through. This chaotic finish would suit versatile types who can adapt quickly.
